'''April 2000 Cincinnati tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Acme Games, Cincinnati, Ohio on 22 April 2000. [[Frank Lamantia]] won it. It is known from Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d574">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-22-cincinatti-ohio-4-22-00d574/ cincinatti-ohio-4-22-00], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 22 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-22-cincinatti-ohio-4-22-00d574/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Acme Games, Cincinnati, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Frank Lamantia]]
